text.name: textDescription
text.text: "Archery Game" is a Roguelite strategy game. Enemies spawn over time and try to kill you. You must avoid them and kill them, but your character can only attack while standing. The goal of the game is to survive as long as possible; the best score is recorded. You take damage if you collide with enemies. If you take enough damage, the game ends. The game gets progressively more difficult and different types of enemies appear. But don't worry, if you kill enough enemies, you can level up. So choosing upgrades wisely is crucial Have fun!
